The apartment itself was great. They gave us 3 keys for the apartment, one of which we left in the keyhole on the inside as that was how you locked it. There wasn't a deadbolt knob to turn, you had to do it with the key. When we left to go check out the city the following day, we left the key in there. We were unable to unlock the door from the outside when we returned. We got ahold of [name] despite it being really late. He came within the hour to assist us. There wasn't a locksmith available to come at that time so [name] knocked the door down, he kicked in the door. We didn't ask him to do that. He left and we went to bed. The door was intact enough to close. The next day, we waited until late morning and hadn't heard anything so I emailed him. They said they'd be around later that afternoon to fix the door. We waited all day long because we couldn't go anywhere as our belonging were in the room. We didn't want to leave them in a room we couldn't lock. They replaced the entire door and handed us the receipt expecting to be paid. I was caught off guard, I felt we shouldn't be responsible for the entire door. I told them no at first and discussed further with [name]. Later on, I agreed to pay for half. They declined my offer. They have tons of good reviews and are very organized. We weren't the first to leave the key in the door (there's another review where this exact thing happened) and feel that if this has happened before, they could have mentioned it. It's also important to point out that in the US, you can't have doors like that. You can't have your egress require a key (door require a deadbolt knob) so it was 1) safe and 2) common sense to leave the key in there. This was just a one off occasion where the situation could have been handled better. The apartment was exactly as described and comfortable, nice location close to transport.

Видимо, жильцы оставляют то, что неизбежно приходится покупать. Мы пользовались кухней, готовили завтраки - это большое удобство. В общем, не нужно строить больших ожиданий, но местечко интересное. This quaint studio is clean and close to transportation! Very easy to get around and see the sights of Prague. Close to market, restaurants and shops and walking distance to a fun beer garden. So many helpful tips, made our stay easy ! Would stay again!

Mini but cute, indeed! We had a lovely stay at [name] and [name] little apartment. Everything was on point, very clean and organized. The size of the apartment was a bit uncomfortable to be honest, but we got used to it pretty quickly. We'd definitely recommend it!

The space is an explanation of words “functional minimalism”, but perfect for two people on vacantion. I would recomend it to anyone, who would like to visit prague with small requirements on space and luxury.

This place is great value, it’s small but light and airy and huge comfy bed. Great area and well worth to explore close restaurants and bars from the apartment! Directions and information all very clear and great communication, thank you :)

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Prag und in dem gemütlichen kleinen Appartment, das uns alles bot, was wir brauchten. Wir können es empfehlen, insbesondere wenn man eh viel unterwegs ist und dort hauptsächlich schläft. [name] und [name] waren zudem sehr nette und kompetente Gastgeber. Gern wieder!

Everything was very smooth, the arrival was well-facilitated, and regardless of the size of the apartment, it was really cozy and it’s located next to an awesome Mexican street food place! The tram connection is helpful for those who don’t want to go on foot. In the first case it takes around 7 minutes, and in the latter about 20

[name] And [name] оставили хорошие инструкции по вселению в апартаменты - это удобно. Расположение жилья отличное до Пороховых ворот пешком 25 минут. Квартира соответствует описанию и цене. Это действительно апартаменты мини, только переночевать, но нам большего и не нужно было. Следует учесть, что под окном стоят зонтики бара и вечером отдыхают чехи, но в 23 часа бар закрывается и можно спокойно отдыхать (при закрытом окне ничего не слышно, но в жаркую погоду душно). Проблем у нас с квартирой ни каких не возникало. Спасибо хозяевам!!!

Nous avons passé un super séjour dans l’appartement de [name] et [name]. Le logement est très bien situé (centre + transports en commun) et le rapport qualité-prix est très bon. Il est très bien pour un voyage de quelques jours à Prague pour deux adultes. Les seuls points négatifs sont l’humidité et les odeurs dans l’appartement. Sinon nous avons passé trois jours très agréables.

We loved staying at [name] and [name]. The place is petite and cozy, perfect for 1-2 people over a long weekend. The area is also quite beautiful, less than half an hour walk from center and if you´re fed up with the crowded center, it´s really nice to walk on these streets and discover new things.
Its very cute mini apartment located at ground floor. Slightly further to city center but there was tramp station right down the street which made travelling so easy. Thanks for being great host.
Such a cute room in a great area! Close to metro, bars and a very nice cat cafe. Highly recommend :)

The flat is located in a really nice area, lots of restaurants and bars and a supermarket within a walking distance. There is a bar downstairs but the noises stopped at 10pm at the latest. Overall we really enjoyed our stay. :) We had some problems with the indoor air in the bathroom area and got some respiratory problems since we have been exposed to it before. Other than that we had no inconviniences whatsoever. :)

Lovely place to stay and easy communication with the host. Must say the bathroom itself is extremely small and not very clean, mould and dirt covered a lot of it and the shower wasn’t very easy to use. Apart from this it was great.
Small but adequate for 2 people. Helpful hosts & easy check in

Perfect little apartment for a short trip to Prague! The apartment has everything that you need! The bed is big enough to sleep 3 people! The location is perfect! The walk to the centre isn’t long at all, however if you’re not feeling the walk then there is a tram stop less than a minute from the front door - so great transport links. Highly recommend.
It’s hard to check in and out of the place because of the safe boxes, they don’t work well.
Super appartement waarbij je veel krijgt voor een kleine prijs. Aanrader!
Byly jsme s kamarádkou velice spokojeny. Rychlá domluva, byt v pořádku, vše podle očekávání . Maximální spokojenost, můžeme vřele doporučit !

L'appartement était petit, mignon et propre. Les indications était très clair et précise. Le bar situé en dessous fait un peu de bruit la nuit. Il y a un adaptateur pour prises électriques américaine sur place. J'ai passer un agréable séjour
The apartment had everything we needed! It's close to the center, has a comfy bed and is clean. I would stay there again :)

Appartement conforme à la description, petit mais pratique pour notre séjour !!
C’était propre, bien qu’il ne faille pas regarder dans les détails. Le matelas était confortable et grand !
Beaucoup de bruit le matin (escaliers à côté de l’appart qui résonnent beaucoup !)
L’appartement est vraiment à côté de la ligne de tram ce qui est pratique pour se déplacer... (comptez 20 minutes à pied pour rejoindre le centre de Prague)
Nous recommandons l’appartement sans soucis !

Great place to stay with everything you need. It's walking distance from the tram and bus stop. Communication with [name] and [name] was excellent. They sent a super useful guide for checkin and tips for the city. Awesome stay!
Good value for money! Towels didn’t smell very nice and no fan was provided so it got quite hot

El alojamiento es tal cual las imágenes. Si bien está un poco alejado del centro, tiene un transporte muy económico Justo en la esquina, o bien se puede ir caminando unos 25 mins aprox, sin problemas. 
Si tienen algún inconveniente, ellos responden instantáneamente los mensajes. 
Es un buen lugar para hospedarse y recorrer la ciudad.

L'appartement est bien situé: dans un quartier vivant avec de nombreux commerces et surtout un large accès au niveau des transports au bas de la porte. L'appartement est très propre. Nous nous y sommes très bien senti à deux.

Lo que mejoraría es el baño, ya que no había mucho espacio (teníamos que abrir la puerta para poder cambiarnos bien). 
La cama es muy grande y cómoda y se agradece mucho que hayan dos enchufes en la cabecera. 
La localización es buenisima. No está en el centro centro y eso hace que no haya nada de ruido. Pero en 5min en tranvía (está justo delante del apartamento) estás en el centro.

Appartement très fonctionnel et adapté pour quelques jours sur Prague, partis en amoureux nous l’avons apprécié. Situé au pied d’une station de tram, il est facile d’accéder au centre ville (ou 25 min à pied pour les plus motivés). À notre arrivée, nous avons été agréablement surpris de découvrir des informations à propos de Prague et les activités à faire !
Nous recommandons vivement cet agréable appartement !

The flat looked excactly as on the pictures: tiny but nice. From the beginning, the communication with the hosts was really easy. It was no problem for us to check in in the middle of the night. The neighbourhood was really nice because of the tram station right around the corner and nice bars with cheap beer everywhere. There is a noisy bar under the flat which wasn‘t mentioned in the description. Also the tiny bathroom smelled really bad and had mold in the shower. There was also hair right next to the bed. We will always come back to prague but probably not to this flat.
We stayed in [name] and [name] apartment for one night. It was perfect for our trip. It was cozy with a very comfy bed. It was also easy to access using tram.

An indeed cute mini apartment in the city centre of Prague. It offers everything needed for a visit in Prague for two people: great localization, bathroom, bed, kitchen and a lot of useful information on your stay at Prague. Highly recommendable!

An apartment is little but very cute. It is situated near from downtown. We almost did not use public transport, walking all the time.
Very comfortable bed)

Alles im allem war es eine zweckmäßige und günstige Unterkunft. Leider gab es am Abend und in der Nacht starke Lärmbelästigung durch den Club nebenan und Anwohner. Morgens um sieben würden lautstark die Mülltonnen vom Hausmeister durchs Haus gezogen, das man dachte das ganze Haus stürzt ein.

For the price this unit cannot be beat. It has mold issues in the bathroom that do make the unit smell. Leaving the window open helps, but if you’re anything like us you really will be only sleeping there.

Район не понравился. Пешком гулять не удобно, постоянно в горку. Смотреть в данном районе нечего, хотя недалеко от центра. Сами апартаменты очень маленькие. Но за эти деньги , вполне можно. Мы останавливались на 1 ночь. Остановка автобуса и трамвая прям в 10 метрах. Так же рядом есть большой супермаркет рядом.

Het appartement is klein. Alles wat je nodig hebt voor een korte vakantie in Praag is aanwezig maar het oogt niet zo in perfecte staat. Maar de prijs is niet hoog en mag je dus misschien ook niet meer verwachten.Het is wel schoon. En de plek is een prima uitvalsbasis om de prachtige stad te verkennen. Dichtbij de tram en bushalte. Het bed op de vide is ruim maar om erin en eruit te komen vergt enige lenigheid. Het lijkt ons niet geschikt voor oudere mensen die niet meer zo vitaal ter been zijn. Maar wij hebben er een geweldige tijd gehad.
Small, but has everything you need. Great value, and very nice and informative hosts!
Excelente alojamiento para descansar y disfrutar de todo Praga. Muy cerca del  transporte público, que te deja cerca de la terminal y de las principales atracciones turísticas.

Good location, close to tram stop. Easily accessible from airport. Direct trams to the city. It would help if [name] and [name] can give more instructions which trams to take to the city centre. We only discovered at the end of the second day that tram 15 takes us right to the heart of the city centre, in front of the city hall ! That was a very pleasant discovery
Great communication with host. Ideal small apartment with everything you would need for a short break. Good location.
Good house, good location and good communication. I will come back again. Definitely recommended.

Easy access by tram or bus - very close to the tram/bus stop.
Suitable for 1 or for couple who just needs place to sleep.
We slept very well, matress was very comfy.
Perfect place for two.

I had a great stay at [name] and [name]’s place! It was great value for the price and in a nice location. The bathroom had a little bit of a musty smell, but other than that I had no problems with the place.
Appartamento accogliente a soli 15/20 minuti di tram dal centro.

Wat is Praag een fantastische stad
app Mini is een hele goede plek om te verblijven. Het is een klein maar gezellig kamertje
 Tram naar de oude stad om de hoek. metro dichtbij en als je van wandelen houd kan je zelfs naar de oude stad lopen in ongeveer 15/20 minuutjes.
Er zit een super goed en betaalbaar eetcafe/restaurantje aan de overkant.
wij kunnen en zullen het aan iedereen aanraden!

The apartment is ok (quite small but if you are supposed to be outside the apartment getting to know the city is good enough). We stayed for 4 nights and we arrived late on the check in date and then we decided to go out for dinner, the other two days we basically were outside the apartment the whole day and came back very late because we just focused at that moment to know the city. The third day we decided to prepare something for breakfast at the apartament but then we realized that we couldn’t use most part of the kitchen due to the lack of cleanliness: the kitchen was full of dust and some kind of short hairs, the sponge to wash the dishes had something white on it as well as short white hairs, the pots were kind of “half washed” because the two they have were full of scabs and finally I checked the freezer and took out the ice container and noticed that it hadn’t been washed for a while because it had mould everywhere. I reported the lack of cleanliness and the answer was completely helpless, the answer was that they didn’t know if we were the ones who got everything dirty so was completely senseless for us. And as long as we received that kind of answer we decided not to tell other things because they were going to be a discussion objective because of the attitude of the owner: there was a smell of cigarettes in the bathroom, there was excessive humidity in this bathroom that caused traces of mould in the tile of the shower and the towels had an smell of humidity. 
The lack of cleanliness, hospitality and service is the worst I have received ever.
Overall a very good apartment especially when you are on a budget!! It takes about 15 minutes to get downtown by feet but there's also a tram station one minute away from the apartment.

The appartment is optimal for 1 / 2 person(s) for a few nights. 
Really easy to reach the city centre.

Alloggio piccolo, ma molto accogliente. Semplice e pulito. 
[name] e [name] hanno organizzato tutto in ogni singolo dettaglio e si sono sempre resi disponibili per qualunque cosa. 
Ottima esperienza. 
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The flat is in a really nice area, there is really good access to the tram and is located pretty close to the center. We were really satisfied with everything that was offered to us in the flat. The flat is mainly foryounger people, as there is stairs to the bed, and i guess an older person would not be able to climb them everytime they need to head to the bed, but the rest were really well organised. The host was really helpful, giving us guidelines and replying to every of our quetions promptly. Thank you.

Logement bien situé, il y a une ligne de tram juste en bas de la rue pour se rendre au centre. 
Il est petit mais fonctionnel pour un week-end.
Il y a cependant un problème d’eau chaude, il y a une très petite réserve d’eau chaude (7-8 minutes /jours), à deux c’est compliqué.

The place is in a great location with easy access to the city centre and main train station via the tram stop less than a minute walk away. The hosts gave lots of information about checking in and how to get there, they also recommended places to go in Prague which was very helpful. However, the whole apartment (especially the bathroom) smelt very strongly of smoke even after leaving the windows open for long periods of time. The apartment didn’t seem very clean (lots of dust) and the bottom bed sheets were stained. The shower was broken so you had to hold it up for use, it also ran out of hot water quite quickly during every use. The double bed also had two single duvets rather than one double, when I messaged the host they said there was no alternative. The price was very reasonable for the location but if we were to visit Prague again I would be willing to pay slightly more elsewhere for a better experience.

It's a great location and the tram station is literally at the corner of the apartment! In Prague moving around the tram is really the best way to go and it's a less than a 15 minute ride to the center of the city. Even though there is a bar right next to it we never heard any noise or any sort of commotion at any point during our stay, nor did we encounter any rambunctious people whenever we came or left.
It  is a small space and the bed is on a loft and that of course means the stairs are a bit steep and the space to maneuver yourself to get into the bed is a bit narrow. Not uncomfortably so, but keep this in mind if you are someone who is prone to bouts of vertigo or with some sort of physical disability/injury. 
You have an electrical outlet next to the bed and a switch to turn off the lights from up the loft so you don't have to worry about making your way up and down the stairs in the dark.
Even though we did not get to meet [name] and [name] personally, we felt very welcomed and had amazing directions so it wasn't hard to find the place or get the keys to the room.
friendly and easy to communicate with. good value place to stay with a solid location.
appartamento grazioso, l'unica pecca era il bagno davvero troppo piccolo, per il resto siamo stati bene!

The good:
Easy to find and let ourselves in following instructions from host.
While small, the apartment is a good size for two people to stay two to three nights.
The heater provided was appreciated.
The ok:
Location is about 30-50 minute walk from most tourist spots such as old town square and Prague Castle. Some museums are closer. The walk is fine for a couple of days but if you're doing a lot of wandering it can wear you out. There are tram routes, but with hindsight we would stay more centrally. The upside to the less central location is that it is quiet (although building can get noisy in the mornings).
The bad:
Shower attachment was broken so had fallen off the wall, you had to hold it with one hand above your head. We informed the host upon our arrival who said someone would look at it the next day, but it remained broken for the duration of our trip.
Shower stays warm for about 2 minutes then goes bitterly cold, regardless of time of day or if a hot tap has been run.
The building and apartment smell heavily of smoke, particularly strongly in the bathroom. Leaving extractor fan on and window open does a little to help this but is still unpleasant, and not an ideal solution in a cold February!
Apartment in general could do with some TLC: kitchen handles are broken; mould growing in bathroom; bathroom is quite dusty; kitchen sink drain smells eggy; some crockery was still dirty in the cupboards; the plug above the fridge worked sporadically.
The apartment is cheap, so if you're really trying to save money it's livable for a short trip, but in future we would pay more to have more central accommodation which was nicer to live in.

Cute little place. Perfect for young couples coming to Prague for a city break. 
[name] and [name] are great hosts.
The apartment is not centrally located, but the walk to the city center is pleasant.

Great location in the nice Zizkov area. Tram right outside. Check in was very smooth. Never met the hosts but got all info needed. 
Apartment is really small. Recommended for single travelers or couples not planning to use apartment for more than sleeping. Really good value for the price.

A tiny-tiny room but in vicinity or in range of everything.  Hope you don`t have in mind to have a room program. The place is too small even to have a decent meal. But-but-but., it deserved all the money I gave.  When excited by the view, I am not in the mood to eat something bigger than an apple or a sandwich. In fact, I presume you come in Prague to visit the city, not to stay in a room. You have an infinity of pubs and restaurants to serve the breakfast/dinner and you should be glad to have a roof to stay under.

Väldigt basic och ännu mindre än bilderna antyder. Mögelvarning i suschen med svarta fogar ikaklet. Städades nästan bort efter min anmärkning och boedetfunkade för tre intensiva dygn då jag bara kom hem för att duscha och sova. Billigt men det ska trots detta vara rent!
Good enough for low budget travelers looking for overnight stay. Neighborhood is a bit noisy so you might get fed up after couple nights.
[name] and [name]'s place... It's just perfect for a couple while visiting the beautiful city of Prague. Nice, small, easy to find and access. Thanks [name] & [name], we had a great time!
Logement assez bien placé et plutôt bien équipé juste l’isolation de la salle de bain à revoir

The Mini-studio looks the same as in the pictures, but now it's overdue. Moisture is felt in the studio and there is note in the studio that says it is recommend to open the window for fresh air. We did not feel by looking at pictures that it is so small, for exp. in the bathroom you can't rotate at all, there is no enough space to sit strait on the toilet.
The cleanliness is not on an high level-the carpet in the bathroom was very dirty, in the tub there was hair and in the whole studio there is a lot of spider net. Heating is based on electricity, but single blower unit and the problem is that when the heater is turned on, all the warm air goes up into the sleeping part and then upstairs is so warm you can't breath but downstairs is so cold you can't even take a shower. The hair drier was broken, water on tap in bathroom is so slow that we washed our teeth's and hands in kitchen sink. 
Positive things are the studio is on good location and is well connected to the center with bus lines, but not with the metro, but this was not a problem for us.

This apartment is cute and VERY ‘mini’ and it’s truly a case of getting what you pay for.  With a total of 5m x 3m that includes bathroom, kitchenette, table and ladder to your very comfortable bed in the loft, it is best for a single person or 2 very companionable people. The bathroom is very tight, so if you are average or bigger than average size, you’ll be keeping the door open while you use it. 
It’s got great access to downtown Prague via the tram and a pub downstairs whose smokers share their smoke with you. 
We had a good time there even so, just don’t expect a lot of room!
Great place to stay close to the city. Simple check-in and check-out.

The apartment is closed to the center, good location, easy to access, everything was as in the pictures. The only thing is the noise your neighbors can make when they slam the main door of the hallway, you feel it in all the apartment.
Fijne plek om een paar nachtjes te slapen, hosts reageren snel en zijn vriendelijk.

Appartement est fonctionnel et très bien situé. Les informations fournies sont détaillées, complètes et précises! Tout est mis en œuvre pour faciliter l’accès et le confort du voyageur. 
Je recommande!

We had a fairly good stay in this mini apartment. Although the bathroom looked larger in the photos, the size was not really an issue. We had some issues with ventilation and airing out sour smells from the apartment. Slight smell of cigarettes upon entry, yet it went away after airing out the apartment. The apartment was in a good neighborhood, but was a bit farther from the city center than expected, being a 45 minute walk as trams were consistently full. Overall a cute apartment and fine stay.

Fácil acceso, ubicación inmejorable, a media cuadra de la parada del tranvía, en 10 minutos ya estabas en el centro. En cuanto al apartamento, tiene todo lo que se requiere para una estancia corta. Es pequeño, pero cuenta con nevera, cocina y baño. El edificio es viejo pero el acceso es fácil gracias a las instrucciones del anfitrión. En el apartamento encuentras una hoja con toda la información general del apartamento y un cuadro con lugares de interés que está muy bien.

В целом для такой цены все приемлимо для недолгого пребывания.
Желательно чтобы хозяин уделил внимание некоторым мелочам.
Отдыхали в Будапеште примерно в такой же квартире и по такой же цене, так там было предусмотрено намного больше всего.
We loved the area! The apartment was perfect for our needs!
Great place to stay.  Super location

The location was great! Just a few Tram stops to all the things you must see. The room is small and basic but just everything you need. The fridge was a bit noisy but we pulled the plug out. And it was a bit hot and stuffy in the room, cause there's no AC. But the price is nice for what it offers. 
We enjoyed our stay!
Lovely AirBnb in Prague, would definitely recommend and come back again! Thank you!

Me and my boyfriend stayed in the flat for six days as a couple.
I'll start and say the location of the flat is great, probably the best thing of it, and the instructions of the owner were informative.
The flat is very small and basic (no closet, no couch, small boiler- which means short showers), not very clean (we had stains and dirt in the bathroom and spider nets and butterflies on the walls). Wifi was very weak to non-existent.
The flow in the bathroom tap barely worked (we needed to wash hands and brush our teeth in the kitchen sink) and the shower head was broken so the flow in the shower was significantly weaker than it should have been.
As we arrived we noticed we don't have a sponge for the dishes and only one roll of toilet paper. When we asked the owner after five days if there's some more paper cause we ran out of paper we were instructed to buy in the Drogerie store near the flat. Now it may seem spoiled, but we've already been to a lot of airbnbs and never had it happened to us.
It was very unpleasant and felt like the owner tries to save on our account just for asking for paper (as said, we were there for six days so it's reasonable).
Under the flat there is a pub, and during the weekend it was very noisy.
There is the phone of the pub owner to call when it's getting too nosy, but as tourists we had no option to call and sometimes the noises start during the night when we are already in bed,  so we were left pretty much helpless.
Overall I wouldn't recommend this flat for people who are looking a convenient and nice stay in Prague, however it is recommended for people who are willing to sacrifice a bit to pay less, and those who know they are going to spend the entire day outside and come back to the flat only for a quick shower and a sleep.
Me
Very good place to stay with perfect location.
Cute place near the tram for the center

Недалеко от центра, это удобно.
Находится на возвышении, это не очень удобно. 
Окна выходят на бар.

Great value! Really easy to get to! Really easy check in. Fun space! Close to lots of places to get coffee and eat dinner and lunch. Great WiFi too!
There is a small private patio downstairs that does smoke cigarettes and if you aren’t into dealing with that kind of stuff, I recommend looking elsewhere.

Ubicación perfecta para coger línea 9 y estar en el centro en 10 minutos. Cómo recomendación llevar propias toallas ya que las que se encuentren huelen mucho a humedad y el baño es excesivamente chico.

Мини студия находится в довольно неплохом месте. В двадцати шагах трамвайная остановка, что решает абсолютно все проблемы с передвижением по Праге. Кроме Праги мы посещали еще Мюнхен, Вену, Дрезден, пользуясь автобусами Flix Bus. Уезжали и возвращались в основном ночью, поэтому расположение квартиры в 15-20 минутах пешком от автовокзала Florenc оказалось очень кстати. Сама студия полностью соответствует как на фото, так и описанию. Проблемы возникли в первый же день - сгорел фен, при этом закоротил провод и отключилось электричество в квартире. В течении дня [name] решил этот вопрос (фен правда пришлось покупать у китайцев). Есть проблема с напором воды в раковине ванной и сломанным креплением лейки душа. Во всем остальном все соответствует цене. Для двух человек, которым нужно жилье, чтобы помыться, перекусить и переночевать - жилье подходит идеально. Кому нужны больший комфорт и удобства - это не сюда. Ищите жилье от 40 евро. Мы рекомендовали бы жилье [name] and [name] для молодой и активной пары, которые любят путешествовать и смотреть мир.
Great access to public transportation, small apartment as stated but roomy enough for 2 persons, great for short stay! Lots of hot water!!

В целом не плохо вариант,для того,чтобы просто переночевать, шумоизоляция конечно не особо хорошая,если чуткий сон,то будете просыпаться .В душевой был грибок,можно было бы и отмыть ее немного.В остальном оч даже не плохо.

We spent a marvelous week in Prague and this flat help us a lot to enjoy our stay. The flat is tiny but has everything you need. Besides, the location is really good. 20 minutes to the centre on foot. We are so grateful!
Thank you for a perfect stay in Prague. The apartment was great for this short stay!

Nettes kleines Apartment. Wie beschrieben. Kleine Mängel bei der Sauberkeit des Bads, liegt wohl auch zum Teil an der Einbaulösung, die allerdings baulich die beste Lösung zu sein scheint.
Die Lage ist super. Von der Kneipe im Haus haben wir nur Samstag Abend minimal ewas gemerkt.

The apartment is cute and small, perfect for a short stay in Prague. It is in a good position because there is tram stop in front and you can  easily reach the city centre, the airport and the central station. I did'n have the opportunity to know directly [name] and [name], but they have always reply me soon and give me some tips to visit Prague. I really recommend you!

As described, small but adequate. Great location, easy walk into central Prague or tram stop 50m away.
